scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config server/local/wrangler.toml
scripts.lint: eslint web/src web/tests scripts server/tests server/local/*.mjs --ignore-pattern '**/gen/**'
scripts.format: prettier --write .github scripts server/local server/tests proto web/src web/tests web/*.mjs web/*.ts web/*.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github scripts server/local server/tests proto web/src web/tests web/*.mjs web/*.ts web/*.json package.json tsconfig.json
